title: Postcard and Tide
author: Dominic Ishikawa
blurb: Emrys Reyes, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
